items.source: A profile is a named, logical group of bean definitions to be registered with the container only if the given profile is active. Beans may be assigned to a profile whether defined in XML or via annotations; see the spring-beans 3.1 schema or the @Profile annotation for syntax details. The role of the Environment object with relation to profiles is in determining which profiles (if any) are currently active, and which profiles (if any) should be active by default.
items.translation: Profile 是一个命名的逻辑 Bean 定义组，仅当给定的 profile 处于active状态时才会注册到容器中。无论 Bean 是在 XML 中定义还是通过注解定义，都可以将其分配给某个 profile；有关语法详情，请参阅 spring-beans 3.1 schema 或 @Profile 注解。Environment 对象与 profile 相关的角色在于确定当前哪些 profile（如果有）处于active状态，以及哪些 profile（如果有）应该默认处于active状态。

items.source: Configuration of the Environment object must be done through the ConfigurableEnvironment interface, returned from all AbstractApplicationContext subclass getEnvironment() methods. See ConfigurableEnvironment Javadoc for usage examples demonstrating manipulation of property sources prior to application context refresh().
items.translation: Environment 对象的配置必须通过所有AbstractApplicationContext子类返回的getEnvironment()方法提供的ConfigurableEnvironment接口来完成。有关在应用上下文refresh()之前操作属性源的用法示例，请参阅ConfigurableEnvironment的 Javadoc。

items.source: In most cases, however, application-level beans should not need to interact with the Environment directly but instead may request to have ${...} property values replaced by a property placeholder configurer such as PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer, which itself is EnvironmentAware and registered by default when using <context:property-placeholder/>.
items.translation: 然而，在大多数情况下，应用级 Bean 不应直接与 `Environment` 交互，而应请求由属性占位符配置器（如PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer）替换`${...}` 属性值。该配置器本身是 `EnvironmentAware`，并在默认使用`<context:property-placeholder/>`时进行注册。

items.source: Beans managed within an ApplicationContext may register to be EnvironmentAware or @Inject the Environment in order to query profile state or resolve properties directly.
items.translation: 在 `ApplicationContext` 中管理的 Bean 可以注册为 `EnvironmentAware` 或 `@Inject` 注入 `Environment`，以便查询配置文件状态或直接解析属性。

items.source: Profile expressions allow for complex, boolean profile logic to be expressed — for example "p1 & p2", "(p1 & p2) | p3", etc. See Profiles.of(String...) for details on the supported expression syntax.
items.translation: Profile 表达式允许表达复杂的布尔型 Profile 逻辑——例如 `"p1 & p2"`、`"(p1 & p2) | p3"` 等。有关支持的表达式语法的详细信息，请参阅 Profiles.of(String...)。

items.source: Properties play an important role in almost all applications, and may originate from a variety of sources: properties files, JVM system properties, system environment variables, JNDI, servlet context parameters, ad-hoc Properties objects, Maps, and so on. The role of the Environment object with relation to properties is to provide the user with a convenient service interface for configuring property sources and resolving properties from them.
items.translation: 属性 在几乎所有应用程序中都起着重要作用，其来源多种多样：属性文件、JVM 系统属性、系统环境变量、JNDI、servlet 上下文参数、临时 Properties 对象、Map 等。Environment 对象与属性的作用是为用户提供配置属性源并从其中解析属性的便捷服务接口。

items.source: If you wish provide profile expressions directly as strings, use matchesProfiles(String...) instead.
items.translation: 如果您希望直接以字符串形式提供配置文件表达式，请使用 matchesProfiles(String...) 方法。

items.source: If no profiles have explicitly been specified as active, then any default profiles will automatically be activated.
items.translation: 如果未显式指定任何活动配置文件，则任何默认配置文件将自动激活。

items.source: This method is a convenient shortcut for env.acceptsProfiles(Profiles.of(profileExpressions)).
Determine whether the given Profiles predicate matches the active profiles — or in the case of no explicit active profiles, whether the given Profiles predicate matches the default profiles.
items.translation: 确定给定的 `Profiles` 谓词是否与活动配置文件匹配——或者在没有显式活动配置文件的情况下，确定给定的 `Profiles` 谓词是否与默认配置文件匹配。

items.source: Determine whether one of the given profile expressions matches the active profiles — or in the case of no explicit active profiles, whether one of the given profile expressions matches the default profiles.
items.translation: 确定给定的一个配置文件表达式是否与活动配置文件匹配——或者在没有显式活动配置文件的情况下，是否与默认配置文件匹配。

items.source:
Return the set of profiles to be active by default when no active profiles have
been set explicitly.
items.translation: 返回在未显式设置任何活动配置文件时应默认激活的配置文件集。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if called with a null array, an empty array, zero arguments or if any profile is null, empty, or whitespace only
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果传入 null 数组、空数组、零个参数，或者任何配置文件为 null、空或仅包含空白字符时。

items.source: If a profile begins with '!' the logic is inverted, meaning this method will return true if the given profile is not active. For example, env.acceptsProfiles("p1", "!p2") will return true if profile 'p1' is active or 'p2' is not active.
items.translation: 如果配置文件以 '!' 开头，则逻辑取反，这意味着该方法将在给定配置文件不激活时返回 true。例如，env.acceptsProfiles("p1", "!p2") 将在配置文件 'p1' 激活或 'p2' 未激活时返回 true。

items.source: Return the set of profiles explicitly made active for this environment.
items.translation: 返回为此环境显式激活的配置文件集。

items.source: Chris Beams, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Chris Beams, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
